title: Choosing a course
instructions: Bir kadın akşam kursu seçmek için bilgi alıyor. Kursları, günleri ve fiyatları karıştırma. Bu sette 3 dinleme hakkın var.

script.speaker: b
script.text: Hi. I'd like some information about your evening courses.

script.speaker: a
script.text: Sure. We have photography, cooking and Spanish. What are you interested in?

script.speaker: b
script.text: Photography or cooking. When are they?

script.speaker: a
script.text: Photography is on Tuesdays and cooking is on Thursdays, both from seven to nine.

script.speaker: b
script.text: I have choir practice on Tuesdays. What about the price?

script.speaker: a
script.text: Cooking is a hundred and eighty pounds for ten weeks, and that includes all the food.

script.speaker: b
script.text: Do I need to bring anything?

script.speaker: a
script.text: Just an apron and some boxes to take your food home.

script.speaker: a
script.text: On the fourteenth of September. There are only three places left.

questions.prompt: Which courses is Linda interested in?

options: She has choir practice on Tuesdays.
questions.evidence: I have choir practice on Tuesdays.

questions.prompt: What is included in the price of the cooking course?

options: There are only three places left.
questions.evidence: There are only three places left.
